allocator.instance: Factory Director — deterministic policy branch (one configured eligible worker per role)
authority_basis: SF-REQ-026 amendment: deterministic policy settles trivial cases

selection.execution_path: existing factory lifecycle via the Node AlienIntent/B-DISP runtime; the Director transitions the Project item and the runtime launches the worker

verifier.independence: separate worktree; fresh verifier retrieves the exact candidate SHA

selection.why: Only configured, doctor-validated workers. The Director never launches a worker directly.

limits.policy: SWF-09: hard dimensions wall-clock, attempts, retries, concurrency, cancellation; tokens/cost measured, never assumed zero

wall_clock.value: runtime 120 min + startup 2 min + stop grace 5 min
wall_clock.enforcement: execution.supervision (systemd transient unit) active in the live profile

cancellation.value: operator stop of the active invocation

tokens_and_cost.value: measured where the provider reports them; UNKNOWN otherwise; never zero

escalation.architecture_question: Architecture Decision Required (AA A5) via Decision Inbox; branch stops
escalation.provider_capacity: PROVIDER_CAPACITY_INTERRUPTION; one replacement worker, then hold

not_granted_here: Release authority. Release is SWF-35 admission performed by the Director on the Project item.
